title: This Fish Lays 300 Million Eggs 🐟 #shorts
description: The ocean sunfish (Mola mola) is one of the strangest animals in the sea: no real tail, a diet of jellyfish, and more eggs than any other known vertebrate.

scenes.text: This fish can carry three hundred million eggs at once. And almost none of them survive.
Meet the ocean sunfish, one of the heaviest bony fish on Earth. Some weigh more than two tons.
It doesn't even have a real tail. Its body just ends in a stiff rudder called a clavus.
It lives mostly on jellyfish, food so watery that it has to eat huge amounts every day.
And when it lies flat at the surface, it's warming up after deep, cold dives, while seabirds pick off its parasites.
Follow for more animals that shouldn't exist.
